يفخه: يَفَخَهُ 1 , (K,) aor. ﹷ, because of the guttural letter, or ﹹ, accord. to the common rule observed in the K, or ﹻ, as though it were of the same class as وَعَدَ, (TA,) [the last is probably the most correct form, as يَأْفِخُهُ is the aor. of أَفَخَهُ, of which يَفَخَهُ is a dial. form,] He, or it, hit him, or hurt him, on the part of his head called the يَافُوخ. (K.)
